items.title: BCB explains decision not to renew Saikat’s contract
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Tuesday clarified its position regarding International Cricket Council (ICC) Elite Panel umpire Sharfuddoula Ibne Shahid Saikat, whose contract with the board ended in April this year.

items.title: 'Extra caution with drives': Hannan's advice echoes Tendulkar's Sydney masterclass
items.summary: Hannan, Bangladesh's highest run-scorer during the Tigers' only previous Test tour of Australia in 2003, believes restraint outside off stump will be crucial

items.title: Bangladesh Men's Emerging claim first tri-series win after poor start
items.summary: Bangladesh Men's Emerging Team registered their first victory of the ongoing tri-series in South Africa, beating USSA by 26 runs via the DLS method in their second match at Tuks Oval in Pretoria on Monday.

items.title: Tunnicliffe ton hands Bangladesh Women's Emerging Team series defeat
items.summary: Bangladesh Emerging Women's Team suffered a 38-run defeat to South Africa in the third one-day match, conceding the three-match series 2-0 in Pietermaritzburg on Monday.

items.title: Litton Das added to Bangladesh Test squad for series against Australia
items.summary: Batter has recovered from calf injury that sidelined him from Bangladesh's fixtures in July

items.title: Shanto: Bangladesh fast bowlers will 'give Australia a tough time'
items.summary: Shanto also welcomed Australia's decision to field a full-strength squad, seeing it as a sign of the "respect" Bangladesh have earned

items.title: Hazlewood: I'd love to play more with Scotty Boland
items.summary: Hazlewood has changed his preparation heading towards the series against Bangladesh having missed eight of Australia's last 14 Tests through injury

items.title: Litton Das named Bangladesh's new ODI captain
items.summary: He takes over from Mehidy, who the BCB hopes will be able to regain top form without added responsibility
